purpose: Observe one new author-code Wine/Ours 25-draw execution with raw strace in a bounded GitHub-hosted Ubuntu container, then attest the independently verified receipt tar.
scope: Prospective process and selected syscall evidence only. No complete read-byte set, original 2020 execution certification, independent scientific truth, human gold, or algorithmic method gain.
paper: Leboeuf et al., NeurIPS 2020, Table 1 Wine/Ours
trace_rule: Require raw strace openat and positive read events for the pinned Wine path; do not infer complete byte consumption or untraced activity.
release_rule: Only a successful second-VM verifier may request a GitHub artifact attestation for the tar digest; that identifies a new workflow run, not the 2020 experiment.
source_redistribution: The repository does not contain the author archive or UCI data; the first job downloads and hashes them before image build.
